server_url.description: Yamcs server base URL, for example https://yamcs.example.com:8090. TLS is derived from the scheme.

instance.description: Default Yamcs instance name, for example simulator.

processor.description: Default Yamcs processor used to read live parameter values.

auth_method.description: Authentication method used by the Yamcs client.

tls_verify.description: Verify the Yamcs server TLS certificate. Disable only for internal ground segments using self-signed certificates.

read_only.description: Always true. Yamcs actions never issue commands, write parameter values, or change data link state.

enable_archive_sql.description: Allow read-only Yamcs archive SQL statements. Disabled by default.

max_rows.description: Maximum rows returned by any single Yamcs retrieval.

timeout.description: Yamcs HTTP request timeout in seconds.

byte_limit.description: Approximate serialized result size limit before truncating returned rows.
